description: Search Polymarket prediction markets by text query. Returns market metadata including question, prices, volume, liquidity, and CLOB token IDs. Uses the Gamma API for real-time market discovery. Chain with: get_clob_market(conditionId) for live order books, get_live_prices(clobTokenIds) for token-level pricing, get_market_open_interest for capital locked, or get_market_resolution for oracle status.
name: search_markets
